title: Lexus LX 570
verdict: Nearly three tons of hydraulically levitated V8 that Car and Driver called the most desirable SUV on the planet. The punchline is that a used one often costs less than the Land Cruiser it's built on.

paragraphs: The LX 570 is the [[land-cruiser/200-series|200 Series]] Land Cruiser in Lexus clothes, and for 13 US model years it was the most capable thing in a Lexus showroom. It sits on a new ladder frame with double-wishbone front suspension and a multi-link solid rear axle, and it uses the 5.7-liter 3UR-FE V8 with 383 hp and 403 lb-ft. Full-time four-wheel drive runs through a Torsen center differential that can be locked, and Crawl Control does the throttle and brake work for you on steep, slow terrain. Then Lexus added four-corner hydraulic Active Height Control with Adaptive Variable Suspension. That system is the main difference between the LX and the Land Cruiser, and it divides owners.

story.heading: FIRST, FOR ONCE
paragraphs: Development of both the 200 Series and the LX began in 2002, and the design was approved in 2004. Lexus showed the 2008 LX 570 at the New York International Auto Show on April 4, 2007. It was the first LX to be revealed before its Land Cruiser twin. The frame was all new. A third of its mass is high-tensile steel, all three crossmembers are hydroformed, and the tow hitch is built into the frame, as on the Tundra. Lexus said the platform covered 240,000 test kilometers in subtropical forest, the Australian Outback and American deserts.

The LX was 102 mm longer than the [[lexus/lx470|LX 470]] on the same 112.2-in wheelbase, and it lost the old truck's plastic lower cladding. The front suspension gave 9 in of wheel travel. ClubLexus quotes Car and Driver calling it "the most desirable SUV on the planet" and cites a 0–60 mph time of 6.7 seconds for a truck weighing about three tons.

story.heading: THE V8 AND THE ROBOTS
paragraphs: The 3UR-FE is a 32-valve, chain-driven quad-cam V8 with dual VVT-i, shared with the Tundra and Sequoia. It drove a six-speed AB60F automatic, and from the 2016 refresh an eight-speed AE80F. Towing went up to 8,500 lb. The electronics did as much as the hardware. Crawl Control works like an off-road cruise control in both directions. The truck also has multi-terrain ABS, Hill-start Assist and A-TRAC traction control, and from 2013 Multi-Terrain Select and Turn Assist, which brakes the inside rear wheel in tight low-range turns.

The AHC has six settings and can raise the truck about 3 in or lower it about 2 in from normal ride height, using a knob on the console. The AVS dampers are diagonally cross-linked through a hydraulic system, an idea Wikipedia compares to the [[4runner/4th-gen|4Runner]]'s X-REAS. One thing the LX doesn't have is the Land Cruiser's KDSS. An IH8MUD member fitting 35s points out that this actually makes big tires easier to fit on the Lexus.

story.heading: THREE FACES
paragraphs: The LX 570 had three distinct looks. The 2008–2011 trucks are the plain-faced originals, with a 2011 bumper update that hinted at the spindle grille. There was no 2012 model year in the US. For 2013 came the first proper spindle grille, plus Multi-Terrain Select, Turn Assist and a five-speed Crawl Control. Lexus unveiled the 2016 refresh at Pebble Beach in August 2015, and it kept only the doors and roof. It brought an all-new interior and the eight-speed, and it was the first LX sold officially in Japan.

The last years brought niche variants. A two-row, five-seat version arrived for 2018. There were 500-unit Inspiration Series runs in 2019 and 2021, and a Sport package for 2020. US sales peaked at 7,915 in 2008, the launch year, and ran between about 3,100 and 6,000 a year after that, ending at 3,563 in 2021.

story.heading: HOW IT ENDED
paragraphs: Production ended in October 2021, when the [[land-cruiser/300-series|300 Series]]-based [[lexus/lx600|LX 600]] replaced the V8 with a twin-turbo V6. Toyota pulled the [[land-cruiser/200-series|200 Series]] Land Cruiser from North America after 2021 as well, so the LX 570 and its twin bowed out together as the last of the V8s.

On the used market the LX 570 is something of a bargain. DrivingLine noted that used LX 570s typically sold for less than comparable Land Cruisers, even though they were pricier and better equipped new. The discount is mostly fear of AHC repair bills. After a decade of ownership, one long-time IH8MUD poster concluded that the system had turned out to be "brilliantly engineered and built," without the catastrophic tales of woe owners had expected.

callout.label: SIDEBAR · THE LX THEY DIDN'T SELL YOU
callout.title: Diesels, superchargers and a 4.6
paragraphs: US buyers only got the 383-hp 3UR-FE. Elsewhere the J200 LX came in several more flavors. The LX 450d used the 4.5-liter 1VD-FTV turbodiesel V8, with 268 hp and 479 lb-ft, from 2015 to 2021. Hong Kong got an LX 460 with the 4.6-liter 1UR-FE (313 hp) for 2012–2014. Gulf and Australian LX 570s were rated at 362 hp.
The wildest was a supercharged Middle East special edition for 2014–2015, rated at 450 hp and 521 lb-ft. That's 67 hp more than any LX 570 sold in America.

engineering_intro: The LX 570 rides on the new J200 ladder frame, with double-wishbone independent front suspension, a multi-link solid rear axle and a frame-integrated hitch. Full-time 4WD runs through a two-speed transfer case and a Torsen center differential that can be locked, backed by A-TRAC. US trucks have no factory axle lockers. Instead of the Land Cruiser's coil springs and KDSS, every LX uses four-corner hydraulic AHC with AVS adaptive damping and automatic load leveling.

engineering.note: A third high-tensile steel, hydroformed crossmembers, integrated hitch. Same frame as the 200 Series Land Cruiser.
32-valve DOHC with a timing chain and dual VVT-i. 383 hp / 403 lb-ft in US trim. EPA-rated on premium fuel.
Lockable center diff and low range. A-TRAC brake traction control. No factory axle lockers in the US.
Six height settings: about +3 in / −2 in. Double-wishbone front with 9 in of travel. No KDSS.
Plus multi-terrain ABS, Hill-start Assist and, from 2013, Multi-Terrain Select and Turn Assist.

generations_table.note: Launch. AB60F six-speed, 20-in wheels, Crawl Control. 2011 brought a bumper facelift and heated steering wheel. No 2012 MY in the US.
First spindle-grille facelift. Multi-Terrain Select, Turn Assist and five-speed Crawl Control.
Major refresh (only the doors and roof carried over). AE80F eight-speed, new interior, available 21-in wheels.
Two-row option from 2018. Inspiration Series (500 units) in 2019 and 2021. Sport package in 2020.

buying_checks.head: AHC leaks and behavior
buying_checks.body: Cycle the truck through Low, Normal and High and make sure it levels evenly. The IH8MUD AHC sticky includes a Toyota diagram of leak-prone junctions. Fluid at those points means you're about to learn a lot about hydraulics. A healthy system also lifts an extra inch or so in some low-range recovery situations, one owner reports.

buying_checks.head: Radiator (2008–2010)
buying_checks.body: Owners of early trucks report cracks in the top plastic tank, next to the molded platform. Look for a wet line or dried pink coolant along the top. Later radiators carry a different part number.

buying_checks.head: Water pump
buying_checks.body: Forum members say 2008 trucks had water-pump problems that have since been fixed. Look for pink crust at the pump weep hole and ask whether it's been replaced. One high-mileage owner paid about $700.

buying_checks.head: Valley coolant leak
buying_checks.body: Pink coolant dripping from the top of the transmission hump at the back of the engine usually means the valley leak: the heat-exchanger cover and union pipe under the intake. It's not hard to fix, but it takes a lot of labor.

buying_checks.head: Driveshaft clunk
buying_checks.body: A 'thunk' when taking off or stopping often points to dry slip yokes and U-joints. Ask when the driveshafts were last greased. One owner paid about $780 for a propeller-shaft assembly to cure it.

buying_checks.head: Starter
buying_checks.body: Several owners have had the starter solenoid fail with no warning and leave them stranded. On a high-mileage truck, proactive replacement is common.

buying_checks.head: Records by VIN
buying_checks.body: The IH8MUD FAQ points out that the Toyota and Lexus owner sites show dealer service history once you enter the VIN, which is a good check before buying.

buying_checks.head: HVAC recirculation door
buying_checks.body: IH8MUD members warn that the recirculation door hinge can be broken by a careless cabin-filter change. Check that the recirc control actually changes the airflow.

repairs.title: Radiator replacement (cracked top tank)
repairs.time: Parts plus labor. The FSM procedure is posted on IH8MUD.
repairs.cost: Parts plus labor. Some owners have had Toyota cover it out of warranty.
repairs.symptoms: A wet line or pink crust along the top plastic tank next to the molded platform, slow coolant loss and a sweet smell after a drive. It's most often reported on 2008–2010 trucks.
repairs.fix: Drain the coolant and follow the factory removal and installation steps posted in the IH8MUD radiator-replacement thread linked from the Common Failures FAQ. Fit the current (later) part number, then refill with Toyota pink long-life coolant and bleed the system. Check the water pump while the front of the engine is open.
repairs.tools: Basic metric sockets · drain pan · hose pliers · Toyota Super Long Life Coolant · new radiator (later part number)

parts.name: Radiator assembly, URJ200 (RAD50384200) — confirm LX570 fitment

repairs.title: Water pump replacement
repairs.symptoms: Pink crust or drips around the water pump weep hole at the front of the engine. It's commonly reported on 2008 trucks.
repairs.fix: Drain the coolant and do the usual front-of-engine teardown to reach the pump. Unbolt the pump, clean the mating surface and fit the new pump with its gasket. Refill and bleed the system. Before you start, confirm the leak is really the pump and not the valley leak. One owner pulled the front of the engine apart only to find the pump dry and the coolant coming from the back of the engine.
repairs.tools: Metric sockets · fan clutch wrench · drain pan · new pump and gasket · Toyota SLLC

repairs.title: Valley coolant leak (heat-exchanger cover)
repairs.cost: FIPG sealant and two union-pipe O-rings, plus a lot of labor if a shop does it
repairs.symptoms: Pink coolant dripping from the top of the transmission hump at the back of the engine, with the water pump area dry.
repairs.fix: Remove the plastic intake runners and intake to expose the engine valley. Remove the aluminum heat-exchanger cover, clean both surfaces and reseal with grey FIPG. Replace the union pipe and both of its O-rings while you're in there. One IH8MUD member called it "a PHH job on FZJs on steroids": nothing technical, just a lot of hard-to-reach bolts.
repairs.tools: Long extensions · swivel sockets · gasket scraper · grey FIPG · union pipe O-rings · new intake gaskets

parts.name: Gaskets, O-rings and coolant pipes (2013 LX570 catalog)

repairs.title: Driveshaft service (grease and re-index)
repairs.symptoms: A clunk or 'thunk' when pulling away or stopping, driveline vibration and dry slip yokes.
repairs.fix: With the wheels on the ground, chocked and the parking brake on, remove the transfer-case insulator (four 12 mm bolts). Paint-mark both flanges, then unbolt the rear shaft at the transfer case (captured bolts, 14 mm nuts) and at the diff. Clean the shaft, grease the U-joints and slip yoke until fresh grease purges, and reinstall on your marks with the fasteners torqued. Do the front shaft the same way. Remember that with both shafts off, only the parking brake is holding the truck.
repairs.tools: 12 mm and 14 mm sockets · 14 mm wrench · extensions · torque wrench · pry bar · paint pen · grease gun with MP grease

repairs.title: Starter replacement
repairs.cost: Parts plus labor (the replacement starter is noticeably smaller than the original)
repairs.symptoms: A sudden no-crank, usually with no warning. The failure is typically in the solenoid, the high-current relay built onto the back of the starter.
repairs.fix: Disconnect the battery, gain access to the starter, unplug and unbolt it, and fit the replacement. Some owners do it proactively at high mileage instead of waiting to get stranded.
repairs.tools: Metric sockets · long extensions · battery terminal wrench · new or reman starter

repairs.title: Spark plugs
repairs.symptoms: Service interval due (one high-mileage owner did his at 120k miles), misfires or rough idle.
repairs.fix: Follow the IH8MUD plug-change write-ups in the 200 Series FAQ. Clean around the coils before removal, swap one cylinder at a time, torque to spec and clear any codes.
repairs.tools: Spark plug socket · extensions · torque wrench · compressed air · OEM-spec plugs

repairs.title: AHC leak inspection
repairs.cost: Inspection is free. Leaking actuators, accumulators or lines are parts plus labor.
repairs.symptoms: Wet hydraulic fluid at line junctions or actuators, uneven leveling, a sagging corner or a harsh ride.
repairs.fix: Use the Toyota leak-point diagram in IH8MUD's LX570 AHC sticky. Look up under the running boards at each corner, at the accumulator globes and at the line junctions. Cycle through Low, Normal and High and watch each corner respond. Use Techstream or a similar scan tool to read AHC pressures and codes before replacing parts.
repairs.tools: Flashlight · mirror · Techstream-capable scan tool · factory repair manual

parts.name: Suspension and AHC components (2013 LX570 catalog)

faq.q: What's the biggest tire I can fit without a lift?
faq.a: The stock size is 285/50R20. The practical limit is about 33 in, and even that meant moving the front fender liner forward about an inch on one IH8MUD member's LX. His 35x12.5R20 build needed the liner moved further, the sidestep return trimmed and the body mount reshaped, with spacers giving about +35 mm effective offset. The LX is easier to fit than a Land Cruiser because it doesn't have the KDSS bar.

faq.q: How much can an LX 570 tow?
faq.a: Up to 8,500 lb. The hitch receiver is built into the frame.

faq.q: What fuel economy should I expect, and does it need premium?
faq.a: Yes, the EPA lists premium fuel. The six-speed 2008 is rated 12 city, 18 highway and 14 combined. The eight-speed 2016 is rated 13 city, 18 highway and 15 combined.

The US LX 570 has a lockable Torsen center differential plus A-TRAC, Crawl Control and, from 2013, Multi-Terrain Select. It has no factory front or rear axle lockers. Owners who want them fit aftermarket units such as ARB Air Lockers.

faq.q: Is the AHC going to bankrupt me?
faq.a: Probably not, if you buy a healthy one. One long-time IH8MUD poster wrote that after ten years in service the LX 570's AHC had turned out to be well engineered, without the expected horror stories. But leaks at line junctions and actuators are expensive, so inspect the system carefully before you buy.

They share the same frame, V8, transmission and transfer case. The LX swaps coil springs and KDSS for AHC, adds more luxury equipment and 20-in wheels, and over time got its own styling, with unique front and rear ends from 2016. DrivingLine noted that used LX 570s were typically priced below comparable Land Cruisers.

The 2008–2010 trucks have the most radiator-crack reports, and owners say 2008s had water-pump issues. The 2013–2015 trucks add Multi-Terrain Select and Turn Assist. The 2016 and later trucks get the eight-speed and a new interior. There is no 2012 model year in the US.

faq.q: Is it a timing belt or a chain?
faq.a: A chain. The 3UR-FE is a chain-driven DOHC V8, so there's no 90k belt service like the LX 470's.
Not in the US. Production of the 2011 model ran late and the 2013 started early, so the 2012 model year was skipped.

faq.q: What does Crawl Control actually do?
faq.a: It works like an off-road cruise control. It controls throttle and brakes to hold a slow, steady speed over obstacles, forward or in reverse. From 2013 you can choose from five speeds, and Turn Assist brakes the inside rear wheel to tighten low-range turns.

mods.why: The aluminum running boards and AHC lines live along the rockers. Real sliders protect both.
The LX has its own front end, so it needs an LX-specific front bumper. The rear is shared with the Land Cruiser.
The factory plastic won't stop a rock. Bash plates and a catalytic-converter guard protect the expensive parts underneath.
Adjustable links let you re-center the rear axle and correct pinion angle once ride height changes.
US trucks came without axle lockers. Air lockers add front and rear locking without touching the AHC.
Nearly three tons of truck needs a winch on a proper bumper and recovery points rated for the job.

baseline_service.intro: The 3UR-FE has a timing chain, so there's no belt to worry about. The LX 570's baseline is about fluids, the AHC and the known coolant weak spots: early radiators, the water pump and the valley leak. Before buying, enter the VIN on the Lexus owners site to see dealer service history, as the IH8MUD FAQ suggests.
